info.name: AI Whiteboard API
info.description:
Backend API for the AI-Powered Whiteboard.

Quick start:
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default http://localhost:5000, matches PORT in backend/.env).
2. Run Auth > Signup (or Login). The token is saved automatically.
3. Run Boards > Create board. boardId is saved automatically.
4. Everything else uses {{token}} and {{boardId}}.

Requests are numbered in the order you would normally run them. If your client does not run Postman test scripts, copy the token/ids by hand into the collection variables.
